label: EXPLORATORY_AND_CONFIRMATORY_SEPARATED

frozen_gate1.note: Do not retune DRS on Gate-1 registered_test. Successors use new families and new claim_ids.

primary_questions: Can operational recoverability predict useful acquisition beyond uncertainty?
Can empirical action values support a policy that is not T2-as-Q?
Does synthetic evidence transfer to held-out generator families and mismatch?
Does any policy show positive decision value under equal-budget deployment-like evaluation?
not_permitted: Rerun Gate 1 variants on the same registered_test until one is positive

delta_min.source: declared from Gate-1 practical_margin_delta and cost of one retrieval (0.10) relative to U_correct=1; not chosen after cycle-2 results

exclusions: Gate-1 registered_test and sealed_replication are not used for successor fitting or G-R. WDI sealed_test is not accessed.
